## Introduction

Cell–cell communication between brain border cells (snRNA-seq, GEO: GSE301590) and HG cells (scRNA-seq), in control mice and 1 or 4 days after AEC injection:

1.  CellChat: communication in PBS (Ctrl) and AEC-treated mice (D1 or D4), and how it changes
2.  NicheNet: ligands that best explain the gene expression changes in HG cells at D4
3.  Communication between the injected human AECs and the host cells, using a published human AEC scRNA-seq dataset

**Input files**

| File | Content |
|----|----|
| `results/snrna/objects/04_border_cells.rds` | Annotated border cells, saved by `01_basic_analysis.qmd` |
| `data/snrna/hg_cells.rds` | Annotated HG cells from the scRNA-seq analysis (columns `Group` with `Ctrl`/`D1`/`D4`, `SampleID`, `Subtypes`), used as receivers |
| `data/aec_reference/Epithelial_cells_subcluster*.xls` | Normalised expression of human amniotic epithelial cells from \[CITATION, ACCESSION\]; genes in rows, cells in columns |

Outputs are written to `results/snrna/cellchat/`, `results/snrna/nichenet/` and `results/snrna/aec_host/`.

## Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(nichenetr)
library(harmony)
library(orthogene)

results_dir <- "results/snrna"
border_object <- file.path(results_dir, "objects", "04_border_cells.rds")
hg_object     <- "data/snrna/hg_cells.rds"
aec_dir       <- "data/aec_reference"
for (d in file.path(results_dir, c("cellchat", "nichenet", "aec_host", "aec_host/pathways"))) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

set.seed(42)

border <- readRDS(border_object)
subtype_levels <- levels(border$Subtypes)
```

## Cell–cell communication (CellChat)

Border cells are combined with the HG cells from the same time points. Communication is inferred separately in PBS (Ctrl) and AEC-treated mice (D1 or D4) and then compared. Osteoclasts are excluded.

```{r cellchat-functions}
hg <- readRDS(hg_object)
hg_levels <- levels(factor(hg$Subtypes))

communication_object <- function(timepoint) {
  keep <- c("Epithelial Cells", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial Cells", "Immune Cells",
            "Ependymal Cells", "SMCs")
  b <- subset(border, subset = Group %in% c("Ctrl", timepoint) &
                               Celltypes %in% keep & Subtypes != "Osteoclast")
  h <- subset(hg, subset = Group %in% c("Ctrl", timepoint))

  obj <- JoinLayers(merge(b, h))
  obj$Subtypes  <- droplevels(factor(obj$Subtypes, levels = c(subtype_levels, hg_levels)))
  obj$Condition <- ifelse(obj$Group == "Ctrl", "PBS", "AEC")
  obj$samples   <- obj$SampleID
  NormalizeData(obj)
}

run_cellchat <- function(obj) {
  labels <- droplevels(obj$Subtypes)
  cc <- createCellChat(object = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
                       meta = data.frame(group = labels, row.names = colnames(obj)),
                       group.by = "group")
  cc@DB <- CellChatDB.mouse
  cc <- subsetData(cc)
  cc <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cc, do.fast = FALSE)
  cc <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cc)
  cc <- computeCommunProb(cc)
  cc <- filterCommunication(cc, min.cells = 20)
  cc <- computeCommunProbPathway(cc)
  cc <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cc, slot.name = "netP")
  aggregateNet(cc)
}

compare_cellchat <- function(timepoint) {
  out <- file.path(results_dir, "cellchat", timepoint)
  dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)

  obj <- communication_object(timepoint)
  cc_pbs <- run_cellchat(subset(obj, subset = Condition == "PBS"))
  cc_aec <- run_cellchat(subset(obj, subset = Condition == "AEC"))

  shared <- intersect(levels(cc_pbs@idents), levels(cc_aec@idents))
  object.list <- list(PBS = subsetCellChat(cc_pbs, idents.use = shared),
                      AEC = subsetCellChat(cc_aec, idents.use = shared))
  object.list <- lapply(object.list, function(x) {
    x@idents <- droplevels(x@idents)
    x <- computeCommunProbPathway(x)
    netAnalysis_computeCentrality(x, slot.name = "netP")
  })
  cellchat <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
  cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat)
  saveRDS(list(PBS = cc_pbs, AEC = cc_aec, merged = cellchat), file.path(out, "cellchat_objects.rds"))

  # Number and strength of interactions
  pdf(file.path(out, "Interaction_number.pdf"), width = 6, height = 3)
  print(compareInteractions(cellchat, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2)) +
        compareInteractions(cellchat, show.legend = FALSE, group = c(1, 2), measure = "weight"))
  dev.off()

  pdf(file.path(out, "Interaction_change.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
  netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat, weight.scale = TRUE, top = 0.5)
  netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat, weight.scale = TRUE, measure = "weight", top = 0.5)
  dev.off()

  pdf(file.path(out, "Interaction_change_heatmap.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
  draw(netVisual_heatmap(cellchat))
  draw(netVisual_heatmap(cellchat, measure = "weight"))
  dev.off()

  # Sender and receiver roles
  num.link <- sapply(object.list, function(x) rowSums(x@net$count) + colSums(x@net$count) - diag(x@net$count))
  gg <- lapply(names(object.list), function(n) {
    netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(object.list[[n]], title = n,
                                      weight.MinMax = c(min(num.link), max(num.link)))
  })
  ggsave(file.path(out, "Source_Target.pdf"), wrap_plots(gg), width = 15, height = 7)

  # Pathways that differ between conditions
  ggsave(file.path(out, "Pathway_ranking.pdf"),
         rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", measure = "weight", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE) +
         rankNet(cellchat, mode = "comparison", measure = "weight", stacked = FALSE, do.stat = TRUE),
         width = 12, height = 10)

  # Selected pathways
  pdf(file.path(out, "Pathways.pdf"), width = 15, height = 10)
  for (pw in c("COLLAGEN", "LAMININ", "TGFb", "FN1", "CXCL", "CCL", "CD45")) {
    if (!all(sapply(object.list, function(x) pw %in% x@netP$pathways))) next
    weight.max <- getMaxWeight(object.list, slot.name = "netP", attribute = pw)
    par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
    for (n in names(object.list)) {
      netVisual_aggregate(object.list[[n]], signaling = pw, layout = "circle",
                          edge.weight.max = weight.max[1], edge.width.max = 10,
                          signaling.name = paste(pw, n))
    }
  }
  dev.off()

  # Signals sent by Ccr2+ monocytes and macrophages
  ccr2 <- intersect(c("Ccr2+ Monocytes", "Ccr2+ Macrophages"), shared)
  for (pw in c("TGFb", "FN1", "CCL")) {
    if (!all(sapply(object.list, function(x) pw %in% x@netP$pathways))) next
    weight.max <- getMaxWeight(object.list, slot.name = "netP", attribute = pw)
    pdf(file.path(out, paste0(pw, "_from_Ccr2_cells.pdf")), width = 15, height = 10)
    par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
    for (n in names(object.list)) {
      netVisual_aggregate(object.list[[n]], signaling = pw, sources.use = ccr2, layout = "circle",
                          edge.weight.max = weight.max[1], edge.width.max = 10,
                          signaling.name = paste(pw, n))
    }
    dev.off()
  }

  # Signalling changes per cell type
  pdf(file.path(out, "Signaling_changes_per_celltype.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
  for (ct in shared) print(netAnalysis_signalingChanges_scatter(cellchat, idents.use = ct))
  dev.off()

  # Outgoing signalling in AEC-treated mice
  pathways <- union(object.list$PBS@netP$pathways, object.list$AEC@netP$pathways)
  pdf(file.path(out, "Outgoing_signaling_AEC.pdf"), width = 10, height = 20)
  draw(netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(object.list$AEC, pattern = "outgoing",
                                         signaling = intersect(pathways, object.list$AEC@netP$pathways),
                                         title = "AEC", width = 5, height = 6))
  dev.off()

  # Signals sent and received by S100a8+ cells in AEC-treated mice
  if ("S100a8+ Cells" %in% levels(cc_aec@idents)) {
    pdf(file.path(out, "S100a8_source.pdf"), width = 13, height = 10)
    netVisual_chord_gene(cc_aec, sources.use = "S100a8+ Cells", lab.cex = 0.5, legend.pos.y = 30)
    dev.off()
    pdf(file.path(out, "S100a8_target.pdf"), width = 13, height = 10)
    netVisual_chord_gene(cc_aec, targets.use = "S100a8+ Cells", lab.cex = 0.5, legend.pos.y = 30)
    dev.off()
  }

  invisible(list(PBS = cc_pbs, AEC = cc_aec, merged = cellchat))
}
```

```{r cellchat-d1}
cc_d1 <- compare_cellchat("D1")
```

```{r cellchat-d4}
cc_d4 <- compare_cellchat("D4")

# Signals sent to and received by HG_2 cells in AEC-treated mice (D4)
out <- file.path(results_dir, "cellchat", "D4")
pdf(file.path(out, "HG_2_source.pdf"), width = 13, height = 10)
netVisual_chord_gene(cc_d4$AEC, sources.use = "HG_2", lab.cex = 0.5, legend.pos.y = 30)
dev.off()
pdf(file.path(out, "HG_2_target.pdf"), width = 13, height = 10)
netVisual_chord_gene(cc_d4$AEC, targets.use = "HG_2", lab.cex = 0.5, legend.pos.y = 30)
dev.off()

# Ligand-receptor pairs reaching HG_2 through Ccr3, and CCL/CXCL signalling to HG_2
pairs_ccr3 <- subsetCommunication(cc_d4$AEC) %>%
  dplyr::filter(receptor == "Ccr3") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(interaction_name)

ggsave(file.path(out, "HG_2_Ccr3_bubble.pdf"), p, width = 13, height = 8)

pairs_chemokine <- extractEnrichedLR(cc_d4$AEC, signaling = c("CCL", "CXCL"))
p <- netVisual_bubble(cc_d4$AEC, targets.use = "HG_2", pairLR.use = pairs_chemokine, remove.isolate = TRUE)

draw(netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cc_d4$AEC, pattern = "outgoing") +
```

## Ligand activity in HG cells (NicheNet)

Which ligands best explain the genes that change in HG cells in AEC-treated mice (D4) compared with PBS? HG subtypes are the receivers; potential ligands are those whose receptors are expressed in HG cells.

```{r nichenet}
obj <- communication_object("D4")
Idents(obj) <- "Subtypes"

# NicheNet v2 mouse networks (Zenodo record 7074291)
lr_network <- readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/lr_network_mouse_21122021.rds")) %>%
  distinct(from, to)
ligand_target_matrix <- readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds"))
weighted_networks    <- readRDS(url("https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/weighted_networks_nsga2r_final_mouse.rds"))

receiver <- intersect(hg_levels, levels(Idents(obj)))
expressed_genes_receiver <- get_expressed_genes(receiver, obj, pct = 0.1)
expressed_receptors <- intersect(unique(lr_network$to), expressed_genes_receiver)
potential_ligands   <- lr_network %>% dplyr::filter(to %in% expressed_receptors) %>% pull(from) %>% unique()

de_receiver <- FindMarkers(subset(obj, idents = receiver), group.by = "Condition",
                           ident.1 = "AEC", ident.2 = "PBS", min.pct = 0.05) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")
write.csv(de_receiver, file.path(results_dir, "nichenet", "HG_AEC_vs_PBS_DE.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

background_expressed_genes <- intersect(expressed_genes_receiver, rownames(ligand_target_matrix))
geneset_oi <- de_receiver %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.3) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  intersect(background_expressed_genes)
message(length(geneset_oi), " target genes; ", length(background_expressed_genes), " background genes")

ligand_activities <- predict_ligand_activities(geneset = geneset_oi,
                                               background_expressed_genes = background_expressed_genes,
                                               ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
                                               potential_ligands = potential_ligands) %>%
  arrange(-aupr_corrected) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-aupr_corrected))
write.csv(ligand_activities, file.path(results_dir, "nichenet", "Ligand_activities.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

best_upstream_ligands <- ligand_activities %>% top_n(20, aupr_corrected) %>%
  arrange(-aupr_corrected) %>% pull(test_ligand)
```

```{r nichenet-plots}
vis_ligand_aupr <- ligand_activities %>%
  dplyr::filter(test_ligand %in% best_upstream_ligands) %>%
  column_to_rownames("test_ligand") %>%
  dplyr::select(aupr_corrected) %>%
  arrange(aupr_corrected) %>%
  as.matrix(ncol = 1)
p <- make_heatmap_ggplot(vis_ligand_aupr, "Prioritized ligands", "Ligand activity",
                         legend_title = "AUPR", color = "darkorange") +
  theme(axis.text.x.top = element_blank())
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "nichenet", "Ligand_activity.pdf"), p, width = 3, height = 6)

# Ligand-target links
active_ligand_target_links_df <- best_upstream_ligands %>%
  lapply(get_weighted_ligand_target_links, geneset = geneset_oi,
         ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, n = 50) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  drop_na()
active_ligand_target_links <- prepare_ligand_target_visualization(
  ligand_target_df = active_ligand_target_links_df,
  ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix, cutoff = 0.10)

order_ligands <- intersect(best_upstream_ligands, colnames(active_ligand_target_links)) %>% rev()
order_targets <- active_ligand_target_links_df$target %>% unique() %>% intersect(rownames(active_ligand_target_links))
p <- make_heatmap_ggplot(t(active_ligand_target_links[order_targets, order_ligands]),
                         "Prioritized ligands", "Predicted target genes",
                         color = "purple", legend_title = "Regulatory potential") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "whitesmoke", high = "purple")
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "nichenet", "Ligand_targets.pdf"), p,
       width = max(8, 0.15 * length(order_targets)), height = 6, limitsize = FALSE)

# Ligand-receptor links
ligand_receptor_links_df <- get_weighted_ligand_receptor_links(
  best_upstream_ligands, expressed_receptors, lr_network, weighted_networks$lr_sig)
vis_ligand_receptor_network <- prepare_ligand_receptor_visualization(
  ligand_receptor_links_df, best_upstream_ligands, order_hclust = "both")
p <- make_heatmap_ggplot(t(vis_ligand_receptor_network), y_name = "Ligands", x_name = "Receptors",
                         color = "mediumvioletred", legend_title = "Prior interaction potential")
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "nichenet", "Ligand_receptors.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 6)
```

## Communication between AECs and host cells

The injected AECs are human, so they are not captured in the mouse data. Their expression is taken from a published scRNA-seq dataset of human amniotic epithelial cells. Mouse genes are converted to human orthologues, and communication between AECs and the border and HG cells from AEC-treated mice is inferred with the human CellChat database.

### Published human AEC data

```{r aec-reference}
aec_files <- file.path(aec_dir, c("Epithelial_cells_subcluster1-2.xls",
                                  "Epithelial_cells_subcluster3-4.xls",
                                  "Epithelial_cells_subcluster5-6.xls",
                                  "Epithelial_cells_subcluster7-8-9-10.xls"))

mats <- lapply(aec_files, function(f) {
  Matrix::Matrix(as.matrix(read.delim(f, check.names = FALSE, row.names = "gene")), sparse = TRUE)
})

# Combine the tables on the union of genes
all_genes <- Reduce(union, lapply(mats, rownames))
mats <- lapply(mats, function(m) {
  full <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = length(all_genes), ncol = ncol(m), sparse = TRUE,
                         dimnames = list(all_genes, colnames(m)))
  full[rownames(m), ] <- m
  full
})
norm_mat <- do.call(cbind, mats)

# The tables hold normalised values, so they go into the "data" layer
aec <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(norm_mat), ncol = ncol(norm_mat), sparse = TRUE,
                                                  dimnames = dimnames(norm_mat)))
aec <- SetAssayData(aec, assay = "RNA", layer = "data", new.data = norm_mat)
aec$SampleID <- sub("_[^_]+$", "", colnames(aec))

# Variable genes per sample, then Harmony integration across samples
VariableFeatures(aec) <- split(colnames(aec), aec$SampleID) %>%
  lapply(function(cells) {
    VariableFeatures(FindVariableFeatures(aec[, cells], selection.method = "dispersion",
                                          nfeatures = 2000, layer = "data"))
  }) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

aec <- ScaleData(aec)
aec <- RunPCA(aec, npcs = 20)
aec <- RunHarmony(aec, "SampleID")
aec <- FindNeighbors(aec, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20, k.param = 25)
for (res in c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5)) {
  aec <- FindClusters(aec, graph.name = "RNA_snn", algorithm = 4, group.singletons = TRUE,
                      resolution = res, cluster.name = paste0("Leiden_", res))
}
aec <- RunUMAP(aec, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

# Remove MHC class II-expressing cells, then split AECs by HLA-G expression
aec <- subset(aec, cells = colnames(aec)[FetchData(aec, vars = "HLA-DRB1")[, 1] <= 0.15])
aec$Subtypes <- ifelse(FetchData(aec, vars = "HLA-G")[, 1] > 0.15, "HLA-G_pos_AEC", "HLA-G_neg_AEC")
table(aec$Subtypes)

p <- DimPlot(aec, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Subtypes") |
     FeaturePlot(aec, reduction = "umap.harmony", features = "HLA-G")
ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "aec_host", "AEC_reference_umap.pdf"), p, width = 12, height = 5)

saveRDS(aec, file.path(results_dir, "objects", "05_aec_reference.rds"))
```

### Host cells with human gene names

Border and HG cells from AEC-treated mice (D1 and D4).

```{r host-orthologues}
hg <- readRDS(hg_object)
host <- JoinLayers(merge(border, hg))
host <- subset(host, cells = colnames(host)[host$Group != "Ctrl" & !(host$Condition %in% "PBS")])

counts_human <- convert_orthologs(gene_df = LayerData(host, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"),
                                  input_species = "mouse", output_species = "human",
                                  gene_input = "rownames", gene_output = "rownames",
                                  non121_strategy = "drop_output_species")
host_human <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts_human, meta.data = host@meta.data)
host_human <- NormalizeData(host_human)
```

### CellChat

```{r aec-cellchat}
aec_types <- c("HLA-G_neg_AEC", "HLA-G_pos_AEC")
label_order <- c("Dural Fibroblast", "Multicilia Epithelial Cells", "Cuboidal Epithelial Cells",
                 "Arachnoid Fibroblasts", "Arachnoid Barrier Cells", "Ependymal Cells",
                 "Leptomeningeal Fibroblast", "Endothelial Cells", "SMCs", "Choroid plexus Fibroblast",
                 "ILCs/NK Cells", "Ccr2+ Macrophages", "Ccr2- Macrophages", "T Cells", "Ccr2+ Monocytes",
                 "S100a8+ Cells", "Periosteal Fibroblast", "cDendritic Cells", "Osteoclast",
                 "HG_1", "HG_2", "HG_3", "HG_4", "HG_5", aec_types)

combined <- JoinLayers(merge(host_human, aec))
combined$Subtypes <- factor(combined$Subtypes, levels = label_order)
combined <- subset(combined, cells = colnames(combined)[!is.na(combined$Subtypes)])
combined$Subtypes <- droplevels(combined$Subtypes)
table(combined$Subtypes)

# Full human CellChat database. To use only contact and ECM interactions:
# subsetDB(CellChatDB.human, search = c("ECM-Receptor", "Cell-Cell Contact", "Non-protein Signaling"), key = "annotation")
db_use <- CellChatDB.human

cellchat <- createCellChat(object = LayerData(combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
                           meta = data.frame(labels = combined$Subtypes, row.names = colnames(combined)),
                           group.by = "labels")
cellchat@DB <- db_use
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
future::plan("multisession", workers = 3)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean")
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
future::plan("sequential")

saveRDS(cellchat, file.path(results_dir, "aec_host", "cellchat_aec_host.rds"))
```

```{r aec-cellchat-plots}
out <- file.path(results_dir, "aec_host")
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
mat <- cellchat@net$weight
cell_types <- levels(cellchat@idents)

# Overview
pdf(file.path(out, "Overview.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count,  vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE,
                 title.name = "Number of interactions")
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE,
                 title.name = "Interaction strength")
print(netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(cellchat))
dev.off()

# Signals sent and received by HLA-G+ AECs and HG_2 cells
pdf(file.path(out, "Overview_AEC_HG2.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
for (ct in intersect(c("HLA-G_pos_AEC", "HG_2"), cell_types)) {
  netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count,  sources.use = ct, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE,
                   label.edge = FALSE, title.name = paste("Interactions sent by", ct))
  netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, targets.use = ct, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE,
                   label.edge = FALSE, title.name = paste("Interaction strength received by", ct))
}
dev.off()

# Outgoing interactions of HG_2 and each AEC subtype
pdf(file.path(out, "Outgoing_AEC_HG2.pdf"), width = 20, height = 15)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), xpd = TRUE)
for (ct in intersect(c("HG_2", aec_types), cell_types)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  mat2[ct, ] <- mat[ct, ]
  netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE,
                   edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = ct)
}
dev.off()

# Ligand-receptor pairs sent by HLA-G+ AECs
p <- netVisual_bubble(cellchat, sources.use = "HLA-G_pos_AEC", remove.isolate = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out, "HLA-G_pos_AEC_bubble.pdf"), p, width = 8, height = 30, limitsize = FALSE)

pdf(file.path(out, "HLA-G_pos_AEC_chord.pdf"), width = 20, height = 20)
netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat, sources.use = "HLA-G_pos_AEC", lab.cex = 0.8, legend.pos.y = 10)
dev.off()

if ("MIF" %in% cellchat@netP$pathways) {
  pdf(file.path(out, "HLA-G_pos_AEC_MIF.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
  netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat, sources.use = "HLA-G_pos_AEC", signaling = "MIF",
                       lab.cex = 0.8, legend.pos.y = 30)
  dev.off()
}

# Signals received by Ccr2+ monocytes and macrophages
pdf(file.path(out, "To_Ccr2_cells.pdf"), width = 30, height = 30)
netVisual_chord_gene(cellchat, targets.use = intersect(c("Ccr2+ Macrophages", "Ccr2+ Monocytes"), cell_types),
                     lab.cex = 0.8, legend.pos.y = 30)
dev.off()

# Signalling roles of all cell types
pdf(file.path(out, "Signaling_roles.pdf"), width = 18, height = 25)
draw(netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing", width = 8, height = 25, cluster.cols = TRUE) +
     netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "incoming", width = 8, height = 25, cluster.cols = TRUE))
dev.off()

# Every detected pathway: chord diagram and signalling roles
for (pw in cellchat@netP$pathways) {
  pdf(file.path(out, "pathways", paste0(pw, ".pdf")), width = 10, height = 10)
  netVisual_chord_cell(cellchat, signaling = pw, lab.cex = 0.8, legend.pos.y = 30)
  netAnalysis_signalingRole_network(cellchat, signaling = pw, width = 10, height = 2.5, font.size = 10)
  dev.off()
}
```

### Interactions specific to AECs

```{r aec-specific}
all_lr <- subsetCommunication(cellchat, thresh = 0.05)
write.csv(all_lr, file.path(results_dir, "aec_host", "All_interactions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Pathway strength sent by HLA-G+ AECs
pathway_score <- apply(cellchat@netP$prob["HLA-G_pos_AEC", , , drop = FALSE], 3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
pathway_score <- sort(pathway_score, decreasing = TRUE)
write.csv(tibble(pathway = names(pathway_score), score = pathway_score),
          file.path(results_dir, "aec_host", "HLA-G_pos_AEC_pathway_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Ligand-receptor pairs for which HLA-G+ AECs are the only sender
aec_only <- all_lr %>%
  group_by(interaction_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(all(as.character(source) == "HLA-G_pos_AEC")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(source, target, ligand, receptor, interaction_name, pathway_name, prob, pval) %>%
  arrange(target, desc(prob))
write.csv(aec_only, file.path(results_dir, "aec_host", "HLA-G_pos_AEC_specific_interactions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Selected AEC signals

```{r aec-selected}
plot_lr_tiles <- function(source, pathways) {
  d <- netVisual_bubble(cellchat, sources.use = source, signaling = intersect(pathways, cellchat@netP$pathways),
                        remove.isolate = FALSE, return.data = TRUE)$communication
  ggplot(d, aes(x = source.target, y = factor(interaction_name_2), fill = prob)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = seq(2.5, length(unique(d$source.target)) + 0.5, by = 2),
               colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_tile(colour = "grey80") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#4575B4", "#FFFFBF", "#D73027"), na.value = "white") +
    labs(x = "Interactions", y = "Ligand-receptor", fill = "Communication probability",
         title = source) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

selected_small <- c("CD99", "SLITRK", "EDN", "DESMOSOME", "CALCR")
selected_large <- c("CD276", "PTH", "PARs", "IGFBP", "EGF", "HSPG", "CD46", selected_small)

for (sel in list(list(name = "Molecules_clean", pathways = selected_small, height = 8),
                 list(name = "Molecules",       pathways = selected_large, height = 9))) {
  p <- wrap_plots(lapply(aec_types, plot_lr_tiles, pathways = sel$pathways), ncol = 1)
  ggsave(file.path(results_dir, "aec_host", paste0(sel$name, ".pdf")), p,
         width = 12, height = 2 * sel$height, dpi = 600)
}
```
